buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

1. GST Certificate should be registered in TAMILNADU. (Documentary Evidence should be submitted) 2. Registered Office should be located in Chennai District / Tiruvallur District / Kanchipuram District / Chengalpattu District (Proof of GST mentioning office address should be submitted) 3. Bidder should have the labour license. (Documentary Evidence should be submitted) 4. The Contractor should submit ESIC Registration Certificate and EPF Registration Certificate. 5. If the agency is registered under MSME (Micro and Small) or NSIC, then EMD exemption certificat e needs to be enclosed. 6. If the agency is registered under MSME (micro and Small) or NSIC, then the valid certificate needs to be submitted to claim exemption of Experience / Average Turn Over. 7. If the agency is registered under MSME (Micro and Small) or NSIC, then Bid Security Declaration s hould be submitted. 8. Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents soug ht in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 9. The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not b e bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 10. While submitting Original Tax invoice to office, GeM Invoice, Attendance Sheet, EPF Statement, E SI Statement, Pay Slip, salary statement and any statutory deductions should be enclosed along w ith the original bill on or before 10th of every month on monthly basis. 11. Payment of salary to contractual staff should be made on or before 5th of every month. 12. Payment will be made 100% upon submission of invoice on monthly basis, in the following month through Bank. 13. EPF contribution is to paid by the contractor up to the maximum wage ceiling of Rs.15,000/- 14. Income Tax at source will be deducted as per rules. 15. Child labour is strictly prohibited and if the contractor violates them, the contract will be terminat ed. 16. The contractor shall ensure that they deploy only qualified personnel at site for the work. The co ntract or must provide suitable uniform, ID Card / Badge, Shoes. 17. The contractor should furnish the detail number of the labour employed by the for the work. 18. The manpower deployed by the contractor as mentioned in the bid document to be maintained a nd if there is any difference in man power, the proportionate amount will be deducted from the mo nthly bill. 19. Contractor should pay DGR rates under Category ‘A’ and other statutory payments as mentioned in the Bid document. 20. The deduction towards ESIC and EPF to be furnished. (Documentary Evidence should be submitte d) 21. Behaviour of personnel employed by the contractor shall in no way be detrimental to the adminis tration. The contractor shall provide personnel of good character, physically fit, efficient, well beha ved and skillful in their duties. 22. Punctuality to duty and unauthorized absence will be viewed seriously. 23. The contractor has to abide by all the terms and conditions given in the bid documents and scop e of work. 24. Bidder will be eligible for revision of wages in lien with DGR order as issue d from time to time. 25. PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contr

acted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer al ongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 26. Pay Slip should be provided to contractual staff and the same should be submitted to this office a long with the bill. 27. The deduction towards ESIC and EPF should be submitted every month along with the bill submit ted for payment. 28. The bidder shall not be under a declaration of in-eligibility for corrupt & fraudulent practices in any Government Department or organization in India or abroad. 29. Failure of the successful bidder in providing performance security and / or returning contract cop y duly signed shall make the bidder liable for forfeiture of its EMD. 30. A list of staff’s along with their photographs attested by the agency including permanent address should be provided to the office for record before taking over the charge. 31. Security money of the contractor will be forfeited in case of breach of any conditions stipulated i n the tender. 32. In case, the contractor to whom the contract is awarded, fails to accept the offer, the authorized Committee shall have the right to recommend / forfeiture the earnest money deposited by the con tractor any loss occurred due to the non execution of the contract can also recover from the contr actor as decided by the committee. No correspondence in this regard will be entertained. 33. A Non-Blacklisting Certificate must be submitted, confirming no such actions by any government organisation within the last three years. 34. ICMR-NIE will reject a proposal for award if it determines that the Bidder recommended for award has engaged in corrupt or fraudulent practices in competing for the contract in question. 35. ICMR-NIE reserves the right to examine the suitability of the individuals to be employed by the co ntractor, with respect to the qualification, work knowledge and experience, in the relevant field. A ccordingly, ICMR-NIE reserves the right to reject any of the individuals to be engaged by the contractor. 36. Antecedents’ verification of employee to be done at your end and necessary details to be furnish ed. 37. The agency/company must be registered under the Tamil Nadu Private Security Agencies Regula tion Act (TNPSRA), 2008. 38. The agency shall deploy trained women security guards at the site as required. 39. Only DGR-empanelled security service agencies are eligible to participate in the bid. A valid emp anelment certificate issued by Directorate General Resettlement (DGR) must be enclosed along wi th the bid document. 40. The age of Ex-servicemen security personnel deployed should not exceed 55 years. 41. The age of women security guards deployed should not exceed 35 years. 42. Deployed personnel should have a minimum qualification of 10th-grade pass. 43. The Police Verification Certificate for each security personnel deployed at the site must be submi tted after the award of the contract. 44. The Security Guards while on duty will not use drugs, tobacco, tobacco products, play cards or co nsume alcohol. He will not sleep while on duty. Penalty will be deducted on each such act detecte d. Security Guards found to have consumed drugs or alcohol while on duty will be removed at once from further deployment. 45. The bidder must submit the signed copy of the ATC Acceptance. 46. The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent a t the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, contract quantity or contr act duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quan

tity or duration. 47. Antecedents verification of employee to be done by the service provider and necessary details to be furnished. 48. ICMR-NIE reserves the right to examine the suitability of the individuals to be employed by t he service provider, with respect to the qualification, work knowledge and experience, in the relevant field. Accordingly, ICMR-NIE reserves the right to reject any of the individuals to be e ngaged by the service provider. 49. Non punctual to duty and unauthorized absence will be viewed seriously. 50. The service provider has to abide by all the terms and conditions given in the bid documents and scope of work. 51. Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support: BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Fr ee Telephone No. for Service Support. 52. Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Dr aft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of Director NIE payable at Chennai. After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of th e DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer withi n 15 days of award of contract. 53. Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Payment online through RT GS / internet banking also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). On-line payment shall be in Beneficiary name Director NIE Account No. 0936201002864 IFSC Code CNRB0000936 Bank Name Canara Bank Branch address Ambattur. 54. Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction detail s field at the time of on-line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Pay ment Transfer in place of PBG within 15 days of award of contract. 55. Failure of the successful bidder in providing performance security and / or returning contract cop y duly signed shall make the bidder liable for forfeiture of its EMD. 56. Security money of the service provider will be forfeited in case of breach of any conditions stipul ated in the tender. 57. a. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written con sent of buyer. b. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining th e prior written consent of buyer. c. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and s everally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-service provider, for and i n respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. .
